label: B25-BRINGUP-PLAN
title: Freeze reference lessons and register the 25 MHz bring-up DAG
scope: Turn the local and GamePC a10-linux-riscv evidence into a bounded LCVEX 25 MHz bring-up plan through BRAM boot and polling JTAG-UART interaction, register the implementation/physical/board tasks, and write a compression-safe main-agent handoff.
reads: T-035 runtime status and R19-R21 timing evidence
LCVEX Catapult top, SDC, BRAM, boot and JTAG-UART sources
validation: git diff --check; every new task/evidence JSON parses; DAG dependencies, write sets, resource locks and explicit assembler/JTAG permission gates are self-consistent.
acceptance: A post-compression main agent can register worktrees and dispatch the three implementation lanes without reopening discovery; no implementation, Quartus, assembler, JTAG or board action occurs in this task.
resource: Read-only inspection and documentation only; no local/gamepc heavy lock required and no JTAG access permitted.
forbidden_regions: Quartus, assembler, JTAG server, programmer, terminal, power or board state
